name: Firestorm Assault Force
description: All ranged weapons gain Assault and +1 Strength within 12".

name: Ironstorm Spearhead
description: Armoured Wrath: Once per phase for each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Liberator Assault Group
description: Red Thirst: When an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that made a Charge move is selected to fight, its melee weapons gain +1 Attacks and +2 Strength until the end of the phase.

name: The Lost Brethren
description: A Noble Death in Combat: Death Company melee attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1, or the Wound roll if the unit is Below Half-strength. Death Company Marines gain the Battleline keyword.

name: The Angelic Host
description: Upon Wings of Fire: At the end of your opponent's turn, up to 1/2/3 Jump Pack units can be placed into Strategic Reserves and arrive via Deep Strike next turn, depending on battle size.

name: Angelic Inheritors
description: Legacy of the Angel: At the start of the first battle round, select two Angelic Legacy abilities (Sanguinary Grace, Carmine Wrath, Their Appointed Hour) to apply to Adeptus Astartes Character units.

name: Rage-cursed Onslaught
description: Maddened Ferocity: Melee attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1, and units that made a Charge move gain +1 Attacks when selected to fight (+2 if Battle-shocked).
